title.instructions: Use a short, descriptive title naming the app area or task.

branchName.instructions: Use lowercase kebab-case with a concise type prefix such as feat/, fix/, chore/, or docs/.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits: type(scope): imperative summary. Keep it concise.

pullRequest.instructions: Write a concise summary, list the main changes, and include a Testing section with the commands run.
